hero_eyebrow: Dizengoff 218 · Tel Aviv · Two decades of color
footer_tagline: Tel Aviv's original bespoke tanning atelier. Twenty years. Never orange.
philo_p1: Every skin carries its own light — an undertone of olive, rose, or gold that decides how color will live on it. For twenty years, we have read that light before touching a single drop of solution. The result is a shade that exists exactly once: yours.
philo_p2: Our solutions are imported, skin-safe, and blended by hand in the studio on Dizengoff. Applied with contouring technique refined over hundreds of brides, editorial shoots, and stage appearances — color that photographs like a week in Mykonos and fades like a memory, evenly and without apology.
pro4_body: Moisturize morning and night — hydrated skin holds color longest. Keep showers short and lukewarm, and give pools and long sea swims a few days' grace. Cared for this way, your glow retires slowly, evenly, and entirely on its own terms.
hero_sub: Bespoke, hand-applied color — mixed to your undertone, never to a formula. Worn by brides, editorials, and anyone who refuses orange.
svc5_desc: Camera-calibrated color for shoots, stage, and screen. Trusted by celebrities and productions across Tel Aviv. On location by arrangement.
pro3_body: This is when your shade develops — treat it like wet varnish. No water, no sweat, no tight straps. When the time is up, rinse in lukewarm water without soap and pat, never rub, yourself dry. What emerges is the color we composed together.
svc4_desc: The finishing gesture. Lifted, tinted lashes that frame the glow — no mascara, no maintenance, six weeks of ease.
pro2_body: Arrive with bare skin — no moisturizer, deodorant, perfume, or makeup on the areas being tanned. Bring loose, dark clothing and open shoes for the journey home. The solution needs room to breathe; so do you.
svc3_desc: שיזוף בשתי דקות. Rapid contour color for the dinner, the date, the flight tomorrow. In and out — glowing — before your espresso cools.
pro1_body: Complete any waxing or shaving now, so pores can settle. Exfoliate gently the day before — polished skin takes color like fresh canvas takes paint. Then leave your skin alone: no oils, no self-tanner remnants, nothing that competes.
svc2_desc: A trial session weeks before, a perfected shade the week of. Photographs flawlessly in white — under chuppah light, flash, and Mediterranean sun alike.
svc1_desc: Full-body bespoke color, matched to your undertone and calendar. Develops in 8 hours; lives beautifully for up to 10 days.
